DISCOVERY GUIDE

Find a useful starting point.

Explore public projects with live demos. Try the demo, inspect the source and check the licence before making your own copy.

What the rankings mean

Popular
GitHub stars and forks, weighted 70% and 30% using logarithmic scores. Spaces use Hugging Face likes. Mixed results compare rank within each source; raw counts are not directly comparable.
Trending
Measured daily star and fork growth using saved observations at least a day apart, with a baseline near seven days ago. Projects without enough observations do not appear. This is not a live social-media trend.
Newest
Repository or Space creation date, rather than the date it entered RepoShelf.
Recent releases
Saved releases published within the last 30 days, ordered by their publication date.
Community discoveries
Public Hacker News and Bluesky discussions linking to repositories, ranked using observed engagement and recency. Coverage is partial; posts and counts are periodically refreshed.
Editor’s picks
Independent editorial selections. Featured projects require an available repository, a successful demo check within seven days and a usable preview. Selection does not guarantee security or suitability.

Your account

Demos, repositories and README links are open to guests. Sign in with GitHub to save likes, sync optional viewing history, verify public forks, submit repositories and send private reports. Forking happens on GitHub; duplicating a Space requires a Hugging Face account.

Account & data lets you download your saved information or delete your account. Analytics is an optional, separate choice in Privacy preferences.

Checks and screenshots

Demo checks confirm that a page loaded at the recorded time. Screenshots show a past observation, and placeholders mean a usable image has not been saved. Neither is a full test of functionality or a security review. You can report a broken demo or misleading listing from project details.

Promotion policy

Paid placement is separate from Editor’s picks and must be clearly labelled Sponsored. The current promotion programme is a Stripe test mode available only to administrators; public purchases and placements are disabled.
